page.layout: One page of text, single column, with running head at top; page number at top right; catchword/signature mark "S" at bottom right. Headings "IN EOSDEM." and "IN AMBITIOSOS." centred between rules. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Induerê formas tam fubinde dispares ? Hac cernis, inquam: nec tuam coargui Sic supra & infra cogitas ignauiam ? Audi ergo, stulte, audire si tibi vacat, Natus labori quum sit homo, non otio. Quies labore redimitur, non otio: Peius nec stillum est otio negotium.
main_text.head: IN EOSDEM.
main_text.p: MOrtalium si nemo nascitur otio, Vrbem ô beatam, curat in qua sedulus Quod quisque rite nactus est negotium.
main_text.head: IN AMBITIOSOS.
main_text.p: OBsecro qui, montis confcenso vertice, captas Alterius versum culmina montis iter: Nec cessas montes adiũgere montibus snquam, Quo tibi sic fuerit tempore parta quies ? Scilicet, vt possis ipsos transcendere calos, Cæli etiam cedet regia tota tibi, Augebitq; tibi terras qui condidit orbem, Hanc expleturo non tamen orbe sitim. Immo vel nunquam siuus potiere cupitis, Vel miser ascendens, Ambitiose, rues: Exstinctóque tibi, cui siuo haud sufficit orbis, Seni sufficient, Ambitiose, pedes.

page.notes: Printed text is a mix of roman and italic; the Latin orthography of the original has been kept. Several readings are uncertain, notably "stillum", "siuus", "snquam" and "calos", which may be printing errors. The running head and page number are at the top; the mark "S" at the foot is a signature.
